messages:
ash: opened a tiny docs PR to add a short checklist + snippets for handling service-side context trims. want node+py snippets, a curl smoke test, and a one-line tradeoffs note.

maria: cool  paste the node idea and i'll slot it into the PR.

maria: draft node snippet:
```javascript
const res = await fetch(RW_URL, opts);
if (res.status === 429 || res.status === 504) await retryWithBackoff();
if (res.headers.get('x-rw-context-trim')) {
  payload.system = shortenSystemPrompt(payload.system);
  await fetch(RW_URL, opts);
}
```

sam: lint note: use fence lang "javascript" and avoid trailing spaces. i'll run snippet-lint after you push.

kevin: i'll add python requests equivalent + a pytest that mocks headers. will keep tests in a follow-up PR so this one stays small.

liz: editorial: add a single-bullet flow: detect -> shorten -> retry -> fallback (smaller model). one-line tradeoff: prefer detect-and-shorten when quality matters, proactively truncate for strict latency. link to errref for 429/timeouts and SDK retry guide.

docs-bot: PR #840 opened by ash  reviewers requested: @sam @kevin; labels: docs-snippet, needs-ci.

ci-bot: snippet-lint failed for PR #840: fenced code language must be "javascript"; trailing whitespace found.

maria: fixing fences + trimming whitespace, and adding the curl smoke test that hits our local harness: `curl -i -X POST $TEST_URL -d @big_prompt.json -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"` expect header `x-rw-context-trim: true`. pushing now.

sam: will re-run lint and approve if green.

kevin: after merge i'll open follow-up with pytest + fixture that simulates the trim header.

maria: thanks all  tagging @liz for final copyedit once CI is green.

liz: will do editorial pass on green.
